items.statement: EBITDA margin rose to 23.25% in Q1FY27 from 4.93% a year ago and 18.47% in Q4FY26.
items.quote: EBITDA margin in Q1FY27 stood at 23.25 % as compared to 4.93 % in Q1FY26 and 18.47 % for Q4 FY26.

items.statement: Revenue more than doubled year on year to Rs 1,914.98 crore and also rose over Q4FY26.
items.quote: Revenue for Q1FY27 stood at Rs. 1914.98 crore as compared to Rs. 871.02 crore in Q1FY26 and Rs. 1824.12 crore in Q4FY26.

items.statement: Export revenue rose to Rs 1,063 crore from Rs 210 crore a year ago, though below Rs 1,212 crore in Q4FY26.
items.quote: Export revenue stood at Rs. 1063 crores in Q1FY27 as compared to Rs. 210 crores in Q1FY26 and Rs. 1212 crores in Q4FY26

items.statement: The EPC business was hurt by supporting the Army network during the warranty period without being paid.
items.quote: EPC side, one of the major downside was this Army warranty period where we were supporting Army network without getting anything,

items.statement: Management raised its FY27 revenue growth aspiration to 40% and above.
items.quote: we, to the best of our estimates, can raise our aspirations for FY27 to a revenue growth of 40% and above.

items.statement: The company aims for about Rs 500 crore of defence revenue in FY27 and says it is on track.
items.quote: we had shared our aspiration of achieving approximately ₹500 crore of Revenue in Defence sector during FY27.

items.statement: The data centre connectivity business is expected to bring about Rs 800 crore of revenue in FY27.
items.quote: But the full year, we are looking at INR800 crores number, roughly about INR800 crores number.

items.statement: Defence and aerospace revenue is expected to cross Rs 3,000 crore in FY29, with a Rs 5,000 crore target the year after.
items.quote: in our Defence & Aerospace business, we should be crossing INR3,000 crores at least. And the year next to that, our target is INR5,000 crores.

items.statement: Management expects to roughly maintain the current quarterly revenue run rate without a decline in profitability.
items.quote: But generally, we should be able to maintain roughly about this kind of revenue. And profitability, I would say, also not decline.

items.statement: Management expects optical fibre demand to continue for at least five years.
items.quote: So, the demand will continue for at least 5 years and maybe more than that, maybe more than that.

items.statement: Fibre-optic drones have created new demand of about 70-100 million fibre km of A2 fibre.
items.quote: Today, there is a demand of almost 70 million to 100 million fiber kilometers of fiber for A2 type of fiber for fiber optic drones.

items.statement: The company is receiving a large number of customer inquiries.
items.quote: And no doubt that we are receiving a large number of inquiries at this point of time.

items.statement: Fibre prices have risen significantly over the last six months.
items.quote: But suddenly, prices have gone up quite a bit significantly in last 6 months.

items.statement: International fibre prices range from about $18 to $28 per fibre km depending on type and count.
items.quote: So, a range I can give you, its range could be starting from $18 per fiber kilometers to $28 fiber kilometers.

items.statement: Spot prices are not falling and could be slightly better.
items.quote: No, spot prices are not falling at this moment. Spot prices could be a little better.

items.statement: Making preform in-house is about 30% cheaper than buying, lowering preform raw material cost.
items.quote: But as on today, make is 30% cheaper than buy. So raw material costs would go down for preform to that percentage.

items.statement: The preform plant should cut total raw material cost by about 10-12%.
items.quote: roughly about 45% is you would say, is preform. So total, there would be 10% saving in raw material cost, something like 10%, 12%.

items.statement: Any preform price increase may cost a couple of percentage points, offset by higher customer prices.
items.quote: There may be a couple of percentage here and there, and that will be offset by the increase in the prices from the customers

items.statement: Management sees the 23% margin as a minimum it can protect based on current orders and raw material costs.
items.quote: So this 23% margin is something minimum we would be able to protect to the best of my information at this point of time out of the orders I have, raw material cost I have.

items.statement: Margins are not expected to decline this year barring geopolitical events.
items.quote: Margins are not going to decline in the current year, unless there is some geopolitical situation, which is out of my control.

items.statement: Telecom product margins are sustainable because raw material and sales prices are on long-term contracts.
items.quote: Yes, I think these are sustainable because we know our raw material prices. We know our sales prices because there are long-term contracts.

items.statement: Total capex this year is Rs 640 crore, including part of the preform project.
items.quote: This year, total capex is INR640 crores, which includes part of the preform.

items.statement: The board approved Rs 215 crore to expand manufacturing of advanced data centre connectivity products.
items.quote: the Board of Directors of the Company in today’s meeting has approved for an investment of Rs.215 crores for

items.statement: A 300 MT per annum greenfield preform plant is approved at a capital outlay of Rs 580 crore.
items.quote: setting up of greenfield preform manufacturing facility of 300 MT per annum with a capital outlay of Rs.580 crores

items.statement: Optical fibre capacity is being raised from 28 to 34 million fibre km, to be completed by December 2026.
items.quote: The expansion of our Optical Fibre manufacturing capacity from 28 million fibre kilometres to 34 million fibre kilometres is progressing well and will be completed by December 2026.

items.statement: Optical fibre cable capacity is being expanded from 34 to 43 million fibre km.
items.quote: Similarly, the expansion of our Optical Fibre Cable manufacturing capacity from 34 million fibre kilometres to 43 million fibre kilometres

items.statement: Data centre interconnect capacity, including subsidiary HTL, is being expanded five times.
items.quote: The manufacturing capacities including Company’s subsidiary HTL Limited is being expanded by 5 times.

items.statement: The order book reached an all-time high of about Rs 26,665 crore, five times FY26 revenue.
items.quote: Consequently, our order book has strengthened to approximately ₹26,665 crore, which is not only all time high but is 5 times of FY26 revenue,

items.statement: The defence export order book is about Rs 2,200 crore and the company is shortlisted for BMP-2 modernisation.
items.quote: Currently, the order book for export is roughly about INR2,200 crores. We have been shortlisted for a major contract for modernization of BMP-2,

items.statement: The data centre connectivity business already holds over Rs 850 crore of orders and more are coming.
items.quote: We already have almost INR850 crores plus orders in our hand, and we are receiving more orders for that.

items.statement: Debt to equity is 0.3 and is expected to stay around that level.
items.quote: The debt equity ratio is very reasonable at the moment, it's 0.3. So 0.3 is there cannot be any more comfortable debt equity ratio than that.

items.statement: The proposed aerostructure acquisition will widen HFCL's role in the global aerospace value chain.
items.quote: The proposed acquisition of aerostructure business will expand HFCL's participation in the global aerospace value chain opening doors for many more opportunities in the segment.

items.statement: Ground was broken on the ammunition manufacturing complex in Andhra Pradesh on 15 May 2026.
items.quote: One of the important milestones during the quarter was the groundbreaking ceremony of our upcoming Ammunition Manufacturing Complex in Andhra Pradesh, held on 15th May, 2026.

items.statement: Ernst & Young has been appointed to advise on restructuring the group.
items.quote: We are actively evaluating various alternatives and, to support this process, we have appointed Ernst & Young as our strategic advisor.

items.statement: The global optical connectivity industry has entered a new growth phase.
items.quote: I am pleased to inform that the global Optical Connectivity industry has entered a new phase of growth.

items.statement: Only 2 of India's 20 fibre cable suppliers can make the high-count cables data centres buy.
items.quote: India, we have 20 suppliers for fiber optic cable, but there are only 2 who can manufacture these kind of cables.

items.statement: Demand is expected to outstrip industry capacity for at least five years.
items.quote: Demand is still going to outstrip the capacity for 5 years, at least I can see.

items.statement: Geopolitical events such as a Suez Canal closure could delay deliveries and hurt results.
items.quote: But if there is some geopolitical situation happens and something changes, which is not in my control or your control, some people close Suez Canal and deliveries become delayed

items.statement: Industry supply will rise, though management expects demand to rise too.
items.quote: So, supply, yes, would increase, but demand would also increase as I can see it.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: I am pleased to inform that your Company has delivered remarkable performance during the first quarter of FY27 with highest ever Quarterly Revenue, Profitability and the Order book.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue rose about 143.62% year-on-year and 32.73% quarter-on-quarter to 2,541.79 crore.
items.quote: Consolidated revenue surged to $2,541.79 crore, increasing by approximately 143.62% year-on-year and by 32.73% over the previous quarter.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded to 25.89%, up 640 bps year-on-year and 264 bps quarter-on-quarter.
items.quote: Equally significant, EBITDA margin expanded to 25.89%, improving by 640 basis points year-on-year and 264 basis points quarter-on-quarter.

items.statement: Exports grew about 493% year-on-year as strategic initiatives translated into business growth.
items.quote: These initiatives are now translating into meaningful business growth, which is also reflected in our export performance representing a growth of approximately 493% year-on-year.

items.statement: The EPC segment posted a loss of around 121 crore this quarter, with losses over the next two quarters expected to be limited.
items.quote: So this I would say this loss which has you have seen 121 or some crores in the current quarter. Next two quarters put together, should not be more than 75, 200 crores.

items.statement: Management now expects FY27 revenue growth of at least 80%, raised from earlier aspirations of 20% and then 40%.
items.quote: I am extremely pleased to share that based on our current expectation and business visibility, we expect revenue growth of at least 80% in this financial year.

items.statement: Defense revenue is targeted at 500-600 crore this year, at least 2,000 crore next year and around 5,000 crore in three years.
items.quote: So revenue this year, as I said, maintained 500 to 600 crores. Next year, we look at least 2,000 crores. And escalation is to take it in three years time frame to 5,000 crores.

items.statement: Connectivity solutions revenue is expected at 800 crore this year and 2,000 crore next year.
items.quote: I've already told that three times in this call that, you know, the expected 800 crores this year 2,000 crores next year.

items.statement: Management expects to reach the 10,000 crore revenue milestone before FY29.
items.quote: We had emphasized achieving $10,000 crore revenue by FY29. Given the momentum we are seeing, I would not be surprised if we reach this milestone much before that.

items.statement: Management expects revenue growth in Q3 over the current quarter.
items.quote: Khushi, you know, quarter on quarter trend, I can only say the revenue which you have seen in the current quarter, there will be growth in that revenue. There would some there would definitely be growth in Q3.

items.statement: The EPC segment is expected to start reporting profit from the first quarter of next year.
items.quote: I think, you know, first quarter of next year you would start seeing profit in this segment.

items.statement: Demand is accelerating across AI infrastructure, data centers and telecom networks.
items.quote: Demand continues to accelerate across AI infrastructure, higher-scale data centers, and telecom networks.

items.statement: Telcos are expected to increase fiber purchases and the company has started receiving concrete inquiries for large orders.
items.quote: In fact, some telcos which had not come to the market are coming up now, and we are looking at the possibility of large orders from telcos also now.

items.statement: Management sees no slowdown in data center demand despite rising US rates.
items.quote: I don't see any slowdown. Because rates going up, you have to view data centers as a point of necessity.

items.statement: Prices rose about 20% in the quarter and management expects them to broadly stabilise with smaller increases.
items.quote: I said this in the last quarter also that looks to be stabilizing. But then it has gone up by some 20 percent.

items.statement: Quarter-on-quarter growth came from both higher volumes and better prices.
items.quote: Again, this growth came from volume and price both. You know, it's not only price, not only volume. It came from both of the things.

items.statement: Data center fiber commands higher prices than telecom fiber due to its specialised technology.
items.quote: So naturally, data center prices would be a bit higher because of higher level of technology and the kind of fiber required involved.

items.statement: Market preform prices have risen about 600%, but the company is shielded by predetermined contracts.
items.quote: They have gone up by 600 percent. 600 percent. I don't have to suffer because of that because I have a predetermined contracts and these are being supplied.

items.statement: Long-term contracts carry price reset clauses so input cost increases are largely balanced out.
items.quote: So there is a price reset clause in most of the cases. Most of long-term contracts, there is a price reset clause. Short-term contracts with four to six months, there is no reset clause.

items.statement: Management expects margins to improve due to more connectivity solutions and high-capacity fiber cable orders.
items.quote: It is going to get somewhat better only because more orders are coming up for connectivity solutions. More orders are coming for higher fiber capacity fiber cables.

items.statement: Margins should improve from higher capacity utilisation, backward integration into preform and connectivity solutions.
items.quote: And then the second, margin is going to improve because one higher capacity utilization or higher capacity available. And second, because of backward integration. Third, because of connectivity solution.

items.statement: The company plans about 1,800 crore of investment across optical fiber, cable and preform manufacturing.
items.quote: our planned investment of across approximately $1,800 crore across optical fiber, optical fiber cable, and preform manufacturing will expand capacities and deepen integration.

items.statement: Fiber capacity will rise from 28 to 34 and then 43 million, and cable from 34 to 63 million fiber km.
items.quote: Fiber optic fiber, you know, itself is going from 28 million to 34 and 34 to 43. Cable is going to about from 34 to 63 million fiber kilometers.

items.statement: Fiber capacity is running at 100% utilisation.
items.quote: Fiber and cable. Fiber runs 100% of the capacity.

items.statement: The 600-ton preform facility timeline of October 2028 will be met despite two to three months of machine supply delays.
items.quote: machine supplies were you know, there were two, three months delays experienced by us which we have already taken into account when we say October 28.

items.statement: The order book stands at 28,900 crore, giving multi-year revenue visibility.
items.quote: Our order book stands at $28,900 crore, providing multi-year revenue visibility.

items.statement: About 70% of the 18,500 crore OFC and data center interconnect order book is from hyperscalers.
items.quote: But out of 18,500 crore, large portion would be from hyperscalers only. Large portion. I don't have the exact number, but yeah, maybe 70%, maybe 70% would be from hyperscalers.

items.statement: The order book grew from 26,000 crore to nearly 29,000 crore despite 2,500 crore of deliveries.
items.quote: I think order book was 26,000 crore if I am not wrong. Nowadays it has become 28,900 crores. Almost 29,000 crores. So it has increased. Though we have delivered 2,500 crores, but order book has gone up.

items.statement: Debt reduction is expected to begin in the current year while old debts are being repaid.
items.quote: Debt reduction, yes. It will happen. Already we are repaying old debts. We have taken some new debts for capex. But finally the debt reduction will start in the current year.

items.statement: The aerospace acquisition, which brings an order book of about 1,600 crore, is expected to close this quarter.
items.quote: Importantly, the aerospace business being acquired already has executed order book of approximately $1,600 crore, providing good visibility from the outset.

items.statement: The company is setting up an ammunition manufacturing complex in Andhra Pradesh on 1,000 acres of allotted land.
items.quote: We are also setting up an ammunition manufacturing complex instead of Andhra Pradesh, as I have already informed you that Government of Andhra Pradesh has already allotted us $1,000 acre of land parcel to set up this complex.

items.statement: A board committee is finalising EPC business restructuring recommendations with a decision expected in a couple of weeks.
items.quote: So another couple of weeks, I think, we should be able to finalize whatever restructuring we finally do. EPC is of course one thing which is under active consideration.

items.statement: India's data center capacity of about 1.6 GW is expected to reach 6 GW by 2030.
items.quote: Current capacity in India as much I understand is about 1.6 gigawatts for data centers. This is expected to become 6 gigawatts by 2030.

items.statement: Current market preform prices reflect non-availability and must fall as capacity increases.
items.quote: So they will come down once the capacity increases, they have to come down to reasonable level which is equivalent to the prices of the fiber which is available at this point of time.

items.statement: Management flagged unpredictable global geopolitical events as a risk to its expectations.
items.quote: Unless there is some global geopolitical thing happens, you know, nobody can predict that. Business remaining, business as such. I am pretty sure. That numbers should be better.

items.statement: Higher interest rates may slow expansion at heavily debt-reliant data center companies, though this should be offset elsewhere.
items.quote: Except there may be some closure, some less expansion in heavily debt debt reliant companies. But that would be offset by Asia, Europe, and demand of telcos as I have already said.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: It is my privilege to present the best-ever quarterly performance in HFCL's history that marks a defining moment in our growth journey.
